hypothesis: Tapered learned MG/EG correction heads and normalized endgame-weighted training can remove the observed endgame regression; fixed H4/H8 and 300/900/1800 epoch ablations measure bounded returns from capacity and training budget.

data.admission: Reuse h4_data.authenticate and all exact v1 audit pins/53-file closure, without altering the v1 contract or evidence. Same retained bytes and original role identities.
data.innerSplit: sha256(UTF8('chessy-h4-v2-inner-20260915') + one NUL byte 0x00 + UTF8(positionFamily)); integer first16 hex modulo5 ==0 is inner-validation; other families inner-training. Existing one-row-per-source-game admission and explicit group-disjoint assertions apply. Reused unchanged for paired v2-control/v3 ablations; no fresh-holdout claim.
data.innerCaveat: New v3 fits do not train on inner-validation labels, but v2 used these labels for checkpoint/recipe selection. These rows were also prior v1 training data and expanded-HCE fit data. This is reused development selection; expanded-HCE inner CE is in-sample, not independent.
data.outerCaveat: NNUE validation was exposed by v1 and v2; v3 decodes it once after one final model freeze, for exploratory transfer only. No fresh confirmatory claim.

training.optimizer: Adam; beta1=.9,beta2=.999,epsilon=1e-8; analytic float64 gradients; deterministic per-seed minibatch permutation; no optimizer restarts
training.schedule: Cosine stretched to each registered configuration epoch budget; refit uses prefix of that exact schedule. The budget ablation changes both duration and learning-rate schedule; not a continuation experiment.
training.loss: Normalized weighted-mean BCEWithLogits(predicted_white_cp/100,teacher.targetWhite), row weight=endgameWeight for admitted coarse endgame rows and1 otherwise, plus .5*lambda*sum((params-anchor)^2). Each minibatch divides by its own positive weight sum.
training.anchor: Shared first-layer anchor and zero output heads/biases, same v2 W1/b1 initialization. For phase model, MG and EG heads independently regularized; no hidden prior fit.
training.baseline: Frozen shipped integer HCE + one rounded residual; phase heads interpolate before rounding. Control uses unchanged v2 implementation.
training.projection: after each update W1,b1 in[-1.9,1.9]; W2 in[-4,4]; b2 in[-2,2]
training.quantizationAwareMethod: Same v2 parameter STE on both learned phase heads; one final tapered-cp rounding omitted only from differentiable objective.
training.checkpointEligibility: Checkpoint every10 epochs; only after QAT starts. Min exact quantized unweighted inner CE; ties earlier epoch.
training.retryPolicy: Canonical no-replace run marker before role decoding. No score-driven changes/retries; fatal errors preserve evidence and stop. Synthetic fixes before real execution permitted.

selection.recipe: Validate all6 configurations x3 seeds complete and finite; any recorded parity/quantization/range reason stops entire selection. For each recipe median-CE representative must have >=100 rows per inner phase and <=1.01x phase CE vs shipped HCE only. Among these choose lowest median inner CE, exact ties listed order. H4 and H8 both eligible; no adaptation after outcomes.
selection.representativeSeed: Median of3 best quantized unweighted inner CEs; seed numeric tie-break; not luckiest seed.
selection.refit: Exactly1 fresh full-shared-train fit of frozen recipe/median seed; epochs median selected epoch across3 seeds; same schedule prefix and QAT start from recipe full budget, retain final epoch.
selection.freezeBeforeOuter: Publish no-replace recipe/seed/epochs decision and final model digest before decoding NNUE-validation. One outer candidate, no reselection; separate test command stays disabled unless full outer guards pass.
selection.qualityGuards: Reuse v1 guard against BOTH frozen comparators: >=0.5% relative CE gain; MAE/RMSE<=1.02x, p99<=1.05x; each phase>=100 rows and CE<=1.01x.
selection.noEligibleCandidate: Publish complete failure/selection report; no outer or test decoding, runtime, data growth, matches or level changes.
selection.saturation: Report matched median-best-CE relative improvements: phase300 vs single300, H4phase900 vs300, EG2 vs1, H8vsH4 at900EG2, H8EG2 1800vs900. A positive gain<0.1% is small within this finite grid; report seed ranges and checkpoints. No universal convergence or saturation claim. The phase-vs-single comparison changes architecture and effective output regularization: identical duplicated heads receive twice the single-head sum-L2 output penalty. It does not isolate phase dependence alone.
selection.innerComparatorRationale: Expanded HCE was fitted on current inner-validation labels and therefore has an in-sample advantage; it is reported but cannot veto inner phase eligibility. Both frozen comparators remain mandatory on exposed outer validation and sealed test with unchanged thresholds. This rule is fixed before any v3 measurements.

quantization.weights: int16 little-endian; biases int32; exact theoretical int32 accumulator/int64 output proofs for<=32pieces
quantization.rounding: phase=min(24,N+B+2R+4Q) both colors; numerator=phase*MG+(24-phase)*EG; floor((numerator*400+24*Q1*Q2/2)/(24*Q1*Q2)), then white sign and shipped integer baseline. Control retains v2 rounding.
quantization.checks: Every chosen development checkpoint: train,inner-validation,authored FENs; final:shared-train,authored,outer. Independent JS scalar BigInt oracle recomputes material phase from FEN. Any numerical failure before selection rejects entire screen.
quantization.sizeCaveat: 13KB permits offline H8 experiment only, not production WASM allowance or integration authority.

test.condition: Separate --open-test-from command after one frozen candidate passes outer and all prior checks, preserving same v1 quality and bootstrap guards; the screen itself never decodes test.
test.marker: Dataset-summary SHA and nnue-test role scoped no-replace registry, independent of contract identity. Refuse if any restored legacy .research-state/*/test-opened.json marker exists. Contract change or renamed output cannot reopen this dataset.
test.failure: Never change candidate after test. Fatal errors consume opening and preserve evidence; no retry.

scope.deviceGate: #84 remains required before runtime integration; reference timing is not device/search timing
scope.formalAcceptance: #175 remains unfinished; no Elo or family-estimator acceptance inferred from offline loss
scope.publication: Only code, exact contract, weight-free reports and source research enter Git. Checkpoints/state remain separately preserved; no automatic new license for derived weights.
